title: Design: renaming to a taken name and the renamed message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Click tier A's name.
  4. Type tier B's name.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Type a new name no other tier uses.
  7. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name field opens.

Step 4:

  • Tier B's name shows.

Step 5:

  • The field turns red with red text "A tier called" tier B's name "already exists. Click away to keep" tier A's name, as in picture 2.36.

Step 6:

  • The new name shows.

Step 7:

  • The title shows the new name and a message at the bottom right reads "Tier renamed to" and the new name, as in picture 2.37.
